title: Callvale after: functions that events invoke
claim: Events now start small functions, while the long conversions stay on the workers and the database is reached through RDS Proxy.
alt: After: an upload to the audio bucket sends an event to the uploads queue. Lambda polls it for the start-job function, which puts work on the convert queue for the conversion workers. The save-results and notify functions finish each job; save-results reaches PostgreSQL through RDS Proxy.

edges.label: event
edges.say: An upload to the audio bucket sends an event to the uploads queue.

edges.label: mapping
edges.say: With an event source mapping, Lambda handles the polling of the uploads queue for the start-job function.

edges.label: work
edges.say: Start-job puts the conversion on the convert queue, and the workers convert the audio.

edges.label: results
edges.say: The save-results function stores the results through connection pooling offered by RDS Proxy.

edges.label: done
edges.say: The notify function tells the customer that the transcript is ready.

notes: Brief 18 story pair, after (pipeline state P2); 2-deep.md#decision-record (after Decision).
